description: Capability for the Calls window (label `calls`, created only by the call part's opener thread, src-tauri/src/call.rs, T-142): listen to and stop listening to events (calls://changed, calls://open, settings://changed), invoke the five calls_* commands its page uses, and settings_get (the page reads the UI language and the call hotkey, T-143). Nothing else: the page never shows, closes or destroys its window (least privilege, decision #45; app commands are ACL-checked per label, T-049, docs/decisions/ipc-acl.md).
